title: Improve the model for me: ways tried on the training folds, a report in the chat, and adopting a winner
request: I asked the chat to build and improve the model; it only suggested. Show the ways of improvement, in which aspects, and do the improvement practically.
spec: A built project's chat gave advice read from its records, and tried nothing.
plan: An improvement run on the training folds only: other settings, the next families, another feature recipe, a blend, each paired with the current model on the same folds
A job, a route and a report in the project's chat with the aspects and each way's verdict
Adopting a way that cleared, for the next final run, which reads the held-back cases a second time and says so
The chat starts it when asked to do it, and only advises when asked how

decisions.decision: The run never touches the held-back cases; its gains are called optimistic in the report.
decisions.why: The ways are chosen on the folds that score them; only the final stage may read the holdout, and a second read is marked.

decisions.decision: A way counts as a gain only by dclab_core.review.adopt: the paired gain beats the margin set in advance and the one-sided 90% bound of the fold differences.
decisions.why: The same rule the models review already uses: a change that does nothing is not kept.

decisions.decision: Adopting is for a way of the same family and features; another family or a blend is chosen on the Models page.
decisions.why: The final stage fits one family with one recipe; the Models override already re-runs what follows it.

decisions.decision: Asked how, the chat advises; asked to do it, it runs.
decisions.why: The owner asked for both, and a question must not start a long job.

change: studio/improve.py (new), jobs/handlers.py (improve job), agentic/routers/projects.py (improve, improvements, improve/adopt), studio/engine.py (the adopted way reaches the final stage), draft/chat.py and draft/api.py (the chat), views/home.html (the report), tests.

findings.defect: Asked to improve the model, the chat suggested ideas and tried none.
findings.scenario: The person said ok improve the model for me and got a list of advice.
findings.cause: There was no way to run experiments on a finished project from the chat.
findings.fix: An improvement job, its report in the chat, and an Adopt that the final stage uses.

measurements.name: An improvement run on a small invented project
measurements.gate: ways paired on the same folds, the holdout uses unchanged, the report in the chat
measurements.result: the ways ran on the training folds, every way scored on the same folds as the current model, holdout_uses unchanged, the job posted its report
limits: a 700-row invented table; the gains it found were not examined as evidence about the method
adopting then running the final stage again was not run

outcome: A person can ask the chat to improve a built model and gets measured ways, what cleared, and an Adopt.
lessons: An answer that only suggests is not an answer to do it: run the experiments and report them.
risks: A way chosen on the folds is optimistic; a second holdout read is marked but still a second look.
A blend cannot be adopted yet (the final stage fits one family).
